content.text: import html from urllib.parse import urlsplit _ALLOWED_SCHEMES = {"http", "https"} def render_profile_link(display_name: str, website: str) -> str: """Return an HTML anchor element for a user's profile page: its href attribute is the user's website URL and its text is the user's display name. The display name and URL are HTML-escaped. Only http and https URLs are allowed as the href; any other URL (e.g. javascript:) yields an anchor with an empty-safe fragment href instead. """ name = html.escape(str(display_name), quote=True) url = str(website).strip() # Reject control characters and whitespace that browsers may strip or # use to obfuscate schemes. safe = True if any(ord(c) < 0x20 or ord(c) == 0x7F or c.isspace() for c in url): safe = False else: try: parts = urlsplit(url) except ValueError: parts = None if parts is None or parts.scheme.lower() not in _ALLOWED_SCHEMES or not parts.netloc: safe = False if not safe: url = "#" href = html.escape(url, quote=True) return f'{name}'
